description: Every valuation satisfying the initial CNF makes every literal selected by a unit-propagation chain true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.unit_chain_forced.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α}
  {ls : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral α)}
  (hrun : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.UnitChain Γ ls)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (hv : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models v Γ)
  (l : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral α) : l ∈ ls → v l.atom = l.positive
